freshnessPolicy: Derived from the gap ledger in this run. A mission exists because a gap is open, not because anyone listed it.

nodes.title: Canonical V9 cannot be reconstructed from the carrier in this repository
nodes.unblockCondition: The founder supplies the V7 or V9 file; part 16 is re-encoded from it and the materializer prints LOSSLESS_VERIFIED against the unmodified manifest.
nodes.nextExperiment: None available in-repository. Six recovery mechanisms were tested with certain outcomes.

nodes.title: The precedence law cannot settle any conflict between operative rules
nodes.unblockCondition: The founder ranks the operative canon in docs/NORTH_STAR_PRECEDENCE.md. The ranks are parsed from that file, so the conflict graph resolves with no code change.
nodes.nextExperiment: None. Inventing an order would be legislating.

nodes.title: Deployment state rests on evidence that has expired
nodes.unblockCondition: Any authorized caller records a contract-bound probe younger than the doctor freshness window, after which the state becomes SERVING or NOT_SERVING.
nodes.nextExperiment: A scheduled probe job, or one authorized manual probe piped into scripts/ubercel-record-health.mjs.

nodes.title: Verified work sitting on a branch and not in main
No cleared payment, accepted delivery, or customer response exists
nodes.unblockCondition: One cleared payment witnessed by a provider reaches durable storage.
nodes.nextExperiment: Owner-authorized activation of the prepared canary.

nodes.title: No configured model provider to evaluate routing against
nodes.unblockCondition: A configured provider appears in capabilities:doctor and one real routed call leaves a receipt naming the provider and model.
nodes.nextExperiment: Founder configures one provider; re-run capabilities:doctor.

nodes.title: Artifacts that cannot be written until something outside the repository happens
nodes.unblockCondition: Each artifact unblocks when its own named condition is met. The index carries the reason per artifact and the gap closes when none is left waiting.
nodes.nextExperiment: None available in software. The nearest is a measured second improvement generation, which needs a first one to have been measured.

uncertainty: Actionability is computed from gap status. A gap misclassified upstream produces a mission misclassified here.
